Landscape composition at 1760 x 1120 pixels (exact 11:7 aspect ratio), designed to remain crisp and readable downscaled to 440 x 280. Input image 1 is the APPROVED CordWipe brand mark, not a style suggestion: preserve its integrated purple chat-bubble trash-can silhouette, lid handle, two vertical slots, chat tail at bottom left, black outline and thin white keyline. Deep ink background, crisp typography, minimal polished flat design. Text exactly: "CordWipe" and "Delete your own Discord messages".
